subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects, should `openclaw agent` recover and replay first, then automatically use the isolated embedded fallback when recovery is exhausted, or should an unresolved outcome fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerunning?
rationale: This chooses the public failure and retry contract for an existing CLI workflow; code review cannot determine the intended tradeoff between avoiding duplicate side effects, returning a prompt result, and preserving established fallback behavior.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with automatic isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain the current fresh-session fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Adopt explicit fail-closed recovery
options.body: Stop after an unresolved outcome and expose rerunning only through an approved explicit CLI option with corresponding help, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Retain immediate fallback
options.body: Keep current main behavior and pause or substantially narrow this branch if the recovery-first interaction cost is not wanted.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with automatic isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then retain the current fresh-session fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session fallback containment behavior that the proposed policy would replace.
